added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite or after_suite gate log (it ran no suite), so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: the four recorded queries each end with a "-- <value>" annotation, which is not a Cypher comment (Cypher uses //), so a reader who pastes a recorded query gets a silently wrong answer: "RETURN count(sn) -- 174" parses as count(sn) - (-174) and returns 2x the annotated value (348 where the doc asserts 174, and likewise for the 102/10/92 queries). The doc's own inline values contradict what its recorded query returns. The exact executed query is preserved in the reviewed run's census.log:17, so the counts remain reproducible from the log, but the durable artifact done_when names does not carry a runnable query.

item_verdicts.diff: Read the single commit 41cd8ff3a commit by commit against base 345868c92; it adds 135 lines across the two HTML files and changes nothing else, and the recorded numbers reconcile with census.log and confirm.log line for line.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/unsourced-ancestry-census.html recording the current count, its bounded query and the query's elapsed time, with the split summing to an independently counted total; the fragment records the count and per-query elapsed times, states the depth bound (*1..10) and row set, and the split closes (10+92=102, and 72 sourced-in-cohort + 102 = 174 chain-cap).
item_verdicts.goal: Read plan §19 (imas-codex:sn-integrity-backlog, section s19) with its goal to re-derive, read-only, how many unsourced chain-cap identities have no sourced ancestor and report the split; the landed fragment docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/unsourced-ancestry-census.html reports 102 unsourced = 10 with a sourced ancestor + 92 with none against live counts 174 / 102 / 10 / 92.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read the reviewed run's manifest: it states "no gate suite (read-only census)", cites census.log and confirm.log, records the live counts and controls, and carries follow_ons: none and blockers: none.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read the manifest's declared write paths; git diff --stat 345868c92..41cd8ff3a is exactly two files, docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/unsourced-ancestry-census.html and docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-unsourced-ancestry-census.html, both inside the fence, with no other path touched.

justifications.durability: the census adds no test (manifest: "no gate suite (read-only census)"); its only control is the partition assertion at census.log:21-26, which would surface a population the queries cannot see, and no guard pins the fragment's numbers against drift.
justifications.evidence: census.log:26 shows the split's two parts summing to the independently counted total ("sum == independent total : True"), but the durable queries at unsourced-ancestry-census.html:73 carry a trailing " -- 174" that is not a Cypher comment, so the recorded query is not faithfully reproducible.
justifications.fit: the fragment follows the node-id-anchored fragment convention of its sibling docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-row-census.html, docked because unsourced-ancestry-census.html:73 writes a Cypher annotation in a form Cypher does not accept.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/unsourced-ancestry-census.html:73 records the chain-cap total 174 as the row set the split ranges over, matching the live 174/102/10/92 the plan §19 asks for.
justifications.reuse: the change adds no definition and reuses the definitions verbatim from the cited records; a search over imas_codex/ for a reader that computes ledger-hop sourced ancestry found none (the plan §19 states the same), so no owner is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 345868c92..41cd8ff3a shows exactly the two declared write paths and no other path.
